caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that appears to be an old-fashioned candlestick holder with a cover or small container on top. The main structure consists of a shallow, wide, circular base with concentric ridges and a central cylindrical stem. Attached to the stem near the base is a round, cage-like ornamentation composed of evenly spaced vertical slats that meet at the top and bottom. Extending from the stem is a rounded, flat handle with parallel grooves. At the top of the stem, a cylindrical container with a fitted lid and a small knob is placed. The entire drawing uses shades of grey, black, and off-white, giving the appearance of a pencil or charcoal sketch on a light or beige paper background. The shading provides depth and texture to the metallic surfaces, accentuating the object’s three-dimensional form. The artist’s signature, "Nevil. Coff 94," is visible in the lower left portion of the image.
title: Whale Oil Peg Lamp and Stand
